title: C: Enum Types
description: Define and use an enum for days of the week, with a function that returns a string name for each day.

steps.title: Day of Week Printer
steps.description: Define an enum `Day { MON=1, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, SUN }`. Write `const char* day_name(Day d)` using switch-case. Print names for MON, WED, and SUN.
hints: Enum values auto-increment from MON=1 to SUN=7.
